info.name: BLS Public Data Series Surveys API
U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Get All Surveys

items.docs: Retrieve metadata for all available BLS surveys. Returns a list of surveys with their abbreviations, names, and descriptions.

info.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Get Survey Metadata

params.name: surveyId
params.description: Survey abbreviation (e.g., CPS for Current Population Survey, CES for Current Employment Statistics, AP for Average Price Data).

items.docs: Retrieve detailed metadata for a specific BLS survey using its abbreviation. Returns survey name, description, and available series information.
